name: How do you account for unique features or custom amenities when pricing a luxury property?

mainEntity.name: How do you account for unique features or custom amenities when pricing a luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unique features and custom amenities are crucial differentiators in luxury properties. We assess their quality, rarity, and appeal to the target buyer demographic. For example, a custom-designed home theater, smart home technology, or a rare art collection display space can significantly enhance value. We emphasize these aspects in our marketing and pricing strategy, ensuring they are properly valued and presented to potential buyers in their respective markets, such as Brickell or Coral Gables.
acceptedAnswer.description: We evaluate unique features and custom amenities based on their quality, rarity, and buyer appeal, integrating them into the pricing and marketing strategy.
